applications.name: Nerve (Service Token / OTP)

applications.name: OpenClaw Suite (Service Token / OTP)
applications.description: Agent tools and gateway — Service Token (machine) or email OTP (user)

applications.name: Hermes Suite (Service Token / OTP)
applications.description: Product/operations agent — Service Token (machine) or email OTP (user)

tier2_github_sso_with_tier3_fallback.name: Tier 2 — GitHub SSO (Primary) + Tier 3 — Email OTP (Fallback)

tier3_email_otp_optional.name: Tier 3 — Email OTP (Optional for Public Access)

notes: Generated from OMNIBUS Section 5 & 6. All public routes must implement 3-tier stack. Service tokens issued by mcp-gateway only. Email recipient always edaneandersen@gmail.com. OTP TTL 15 minutes.
